privacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPage.intro: Thank you for using XTrader. We value your personal information and privacy protection. This policy explains how we collect, use, store, and share your information, as well as the rights you have.
privacyPage.operatorValue: XTrader is operated by an individual developer.
privacyPage.quickRef1Desc: Email, API keys, trading data, device logs
privacyPage.quickRef2Desc: Execute trades, AI strategies, risk control, service improvement
privacyPage.quickRef3Title: Who do we share data with?
privacyPage.quickRef4Desc: Access, delete, correct, object, data portability
privacyPage.intro1P1: XTrader is an AI-based cryptocurrency quantitative trading tool operated by an individual developer.
privacyPage.intro1P3: This policy does not apply to:
privacyPage.intro1L4: Third-party exchanges (Binance, Hyperliquid, Bybit) privacy practices - Please refer to their respective privacy policies
privacyPage.intro1Important1: Age Restriction: You must be 18 years or older to use XTrader. We do not provide services to minors.
privacyPage.intro1Important2: Financial Nature: XTrader involves cryptocurrency trading with risk of capital loss.
privacyPage.dataCollectDesc: We collect the following types of data to provide services, ensure security, and improve product experience.
privacyPage.dataContactL1: Email Address: Used for account creation, authentication, important notifications
privacyPage.dataContactL2: Apple Data Type: Contact Info → Email Address
privacyPage.dataContactL3: Linked to You: Yes | Used for Tracking: No
privacyPage.dataCredentialsL1: Password: Stored encrypted with hash (we cannot view your original password)
privacyPage.dataCredentialsL2: Apple Data Type: Sensitive Info (authentication info)
privacyPage.dataCredentialsL3: Linked to You: Yes | Used for Tracking: No
privacyPage.dataAPIL1: API public and private keys (encrypted storage)
privacyPage.dataAPIL2: Permission scope: Read account, place orders, query positions (authorized by you)
privacyPage.dataAPISec2: Only decrypted during trade execution and transmitted via TLS to exchanges
privacyPage.dataAPISec3: We recommend granting only necessary minimal permissions, disable withdrawal permissions
privacyPage.dataAPIL3: Apple Data Type: Sensitive Info → Other Sensitive Info
privacyPage.dataAPIL4: Linked to You: Yes | Used for Tracking: No
privacyPage.dataTradingL1: Order history: Buy/sell orders, price, quantity, timestamp
privacyPage.dataTradingL2: Current positions: Currency, leverage, unrealized PnL
privacyPage.dataTradingL4: Source: Synced via API from connected exchanges
privacyPage.dataTradingL5: Apple Data Type: Financial Info → Other Financial Info
privacyPage.dataTradingL6: Linked to You: Yes | Used for Tracking: No
privacyPage.dataNotCollectDesc: To protect your privacy, we explicitly state:
privacyPage.dataNotCollectL1: Location Data: We do not collect GPS or precise location
privacyPage.dataNotCollectL2: Contacts/Photos: We do not access your contacts or photo album
privacyPage.dataNotCollectL3: Browsing History: We do not track browsing behavior outside the app
privacyPage.dataNotCollectL4: Advertising Identifier (IDFA): We do not use any tracking technology
privacyPage.dataNotCollectL5: Biometric Raw Data: We do not use Face ID/Touch ID
privacyPage.dataNotCollectL6: Crash Reporting Services: We do not use third-party crash reporting tools
privacyPage.dataUseDesc: We only use your data within the following explicit purposes.
privacyPage.dataUseCoreL1: Account Management: Create, verify and manage accounts, authentication
privacyPage.dataUseCoreL2: Trade Execution: Connect exchanges, execute buy/sell, sync positions & PnL
privacyPage.dataUseCoreL3: AI Strategy Generation: Send market data to AI models (DeepSeek/Qwen/Claude) to generate trading recommendations
privacyPage.dataUseCoreL4: Risk Management: Execute stop-loss/take-profit, position limit checks
privacyPage.dataUseCoreData: Involves Data: Email, API keys, strategy configuration, trading data
privacyPage.thirdPartyDesc: We work with the following third parties to provide services. All third parties are contractually bound to protect your data.
privacyPage.aiProviderData: Market data, strategy parameters (no personal identifying information)
privacyPage.aiProtectionL1: We do not send your email, name, or account ID to AI providers
privacyPage.aiProtectionL2: Market data (such as BTC price) itself contains no personal information
privacyPage.aiProtectionL3: AI providers are contractually bound not to use data for other purposes
privacyPage.exchangesNote: Important Note: The following exchanges are connected by your active authorization, data sharing is based on your explicit instructions.
privacyPage.exchangeControlL1: You can disconnect exchange connections in XTrader at any time
privacyPage.exchangeControlL2: We recommend when setting API keys on exchanges:
privacyPage.infraNote: Note: CloudCone acts as a 'data processor' role, only processes data according to our instructions, cannot use it independently. For EU users, we safeguard data transfer security through Standard Contractual Clauses (SCC).
privacyPage.paymentSecurityL1: Payment card information is processed directly by Stripe, we do not store complete card numbers
privacyPage.paymentSecurityL2: Stripe complies with PCI-DSS security standards
privacyPage.notUseL1: Advertising networks (such as Google Ads, Facebook Pixel)
privacyPage.notUseL2: Third-party analytics tools (such as Google Analytics, Firebase)
privacyPage.notUseL3: Social media plugins (such as Facebook Like button)
privacyPage.contactDesc: If you have any questions about this privacy policy or want to exercise your privacy rights, please contact us:
